files.config.toml:
me = "Alex Smith"
email = "Alex@Example.com"
org_domain = "Example.com"
workspace = "work"
output = "preps"
owner = "Alex"
house_rules = "house.md"
state_file = "state.json"
log_file = "log.txt"
after_write = ["python", "after.py"]
noise_rules = "triage.toml"
noise_senders = ['receipts@shop\.example']
mail_skip_folders = ["AInbox - External", "junk email"]


[kind.report]
describe = "weekly 1:1 with {name}, who reports to Alex"
rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

[kind.manager]
describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

[person."Pat Boss"]
kind = "manager"
slug = "pat-boss"
file = "{date}-pat-boss-prep.md"
always_day_before_at = "14:00"

[person."Kim Lee"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "kim-lee"
file = "{date}-kim-lee-catchup-prep.md"
due_same_day_at = "09:30"

[person."Zoë Ñúñez"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "zoe-nunez"
file = "peers/{date}-zoe-nunez-prep.md"

[series."Leads weekly"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-prep.md"
members = ["Sam Jones", "Kim Lee"]
chat = "Leads chat"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]
absorbs = "Leads pre-meet"
due_previous_working_day_at = "15:00"

[series."Leads pre-meet"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-premeet-prep.md"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "10:00", end = "10:30"}, {day = "Fri", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]

[series."Weekly note"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{week}-weekly-note.md"

[aliases]
"Sam J" = "Sam Jones"
"Patricia Boss" = "Pat Boss"

files.config.toml:
me = "Alex Smith"
email = "Alex@Example.com"
org_domain = "Example.com"
workspace = "work"
output = "preps"
owner = "Alex"
house_rules = "house.md"
state_file = "state.json"
log_file = "log.txt"
after_write = ["python", "after.py"]
noise_rules = "triage.toml"
noise_senders = ['receipts@shop\.example']
mail_skip_folders = ["AInbox - External", "junk email"]


[kind.report]
describe = "weekly 1:1 with {name}, who reports to Alex"
rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

[kind.manager]
describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

[person."Pat Boss"]
kind = "manager"
slug = "pat-boss"
file = "{date}-pat-boss-prep.md"
always_day_before_at = "14:00"

[person."Kim Lee"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "kim-lee"
file = "{date}-kim-lee-catchup-prep.md"
due_same_day_at = "09:30"

[person."Zoë Ñúñez"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "zoe-nunez"
file = "peers/{date}-zoe-nunez-prep.md"

[series."Leads weekly"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-prep.md"
members = ["Sam Jones", "Kim Lee"]
chat = "Leads chat"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]
absorbs = "Leads pre-meet"
due_previous_working_day_at = "15:00"

[series."Leads pre-meet"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-premeet-prep.md"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "10:00", end = "10:30"}, {day = "Fri", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]

[series."Weekly note"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{week}-weekly-note.md"

[aliases]
"Sam J" = "Sam Jones"
"Patricia Boss" = "Pat Boss"

Then the summaries.

action = 'delete'

match = '(?i)\bsmart detection\b'

[[rule]]

action = 'review'

files.config.toml:
me = "Alex Smith"
email = "Alex@Example.com"
org_domain = "Example.com"
workspace = "work"
output = "preps"
owner = "Alex"
house_rules = "house.md"
state_file = "state.json"
log_file = "log.txt"
after_write = ["python", "after.py"]
noise_rules = "triage.toml"

[kind.report]
describe = "weekly 1:1 with {name}, who reports to Alex"
rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

[kind.manager]
describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

[person."Pat Boss"]
kind = "manager"
slug = "pat-boss"
file = "{date}-pat-boss-prep.md"
always_day_before_at = "14:00"

[person."Kim Lee"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "kim-lee"
file = "{date}-kim-lee-catchup-prep.md"
due_same_day_at = "09:30"

[person."Zoë Ñúñez"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "zoe-nunez"
file = "peers/{date}-zoe-nunez-prep.md"

file = "{date}-leads-prep.md"
members = ["Sam Jones", "Kim Lee"]

weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]
absorbs = "Leads pre-meet"
due_previous_working_day_at = "15:00"

kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-premeet-prep.md"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "10:00", end = "10:30"}, {day = "Fri", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]

[series."Weekly note"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{week}-weekly-note.md"

[aliases]
"Sam J" = "Sam Jones"
"Patricia Boss" = "Pat Boss"

rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

[kind.manager]
describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

[person."Pat Boss"]
kind = "manager"
slug = "pat-boss"
file = "{date}-pat-boss-prep.md"
always_day_before_at = "14:00"

[person."Kim Lee"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "kim-lee"
file = "{date}-kim-lee-catchup-prep.md"
due_same_day_at = "09:30"

[person."Zoë Ñúñez"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "zoe-nunez"
file = "peers/{date}-zoe-nunez-prep.md"

[series."Leads weekly"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-prep.md"
members = ["Sam Jones", "Kim Lee"]
chat = "Leads chat"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]
absorbs = "Leads pre-meet"
due_previous_working_day_at = "15:00"

[series."Leads pre-meet"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-premeet-prep.md"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "10:00", end = "10:30"}, {day = "Fri", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]

[series."Weekly note"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{week}-weekly-note.md"

[aliases]
"Sam J" = "Sam Jones"
"Patricia Boss" = "Pat Boss"
files.house.md:
- No code names.
- Dates as dates.
files.kinds/manager.md:
Read the manager notes.
Then the summaries.
files.triage.toml:
[[rule]]
sender = 'news@vendor\.example$'
action = 'delete'

[[rule]]
sender = '@example\.com$'
match = '^Accepted: '
action = 'delete'

[[rule]]
sender = 'alerts@'
match = '(?i)\bsmart detection\b'
action = 'resolve'

[[rule]]
sender = 'keep@'
action = 'review'

me = "Alex Smith"
email = "Alex@Example.com"

workspace = "work"
output = "preps"
owner = "Alex"

[kind.report]
describe = "weekly 1:1 with {name}, who reports to Alex"
rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

due_same_day_at = "09:30"

[person."Zoë Ñúñez"]

[series."Weekly note"]

"Sam J" = "Sam Jones"

me = "Alex Smith"
email = "Alex@Example.com"
org_domain = "Example.com"
workspace = "work"
output = "preps"
owner = "Alex"
house_rules = "house.md"
state_file = "state.json"
log_file = "log.txt"
after_write = ["python", "after.py"]
noise_rules = "triage.toml"
noise_senders = ['receipts@shop\.example']
mail_skip_folders = ["AInbox - External", "junk email"]


[kind.report]
describe = "weekly 1:1 with {name}, who reports to Alex"
rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

[kind.manager]
describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

file = "{date}-pat-boss-prep.md"

absorbs = "Leads pre-meet"

weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "10:00", end = "10:30"}, {day = "Fri", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]

[series."Weekly note"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{week}-weekly-note.md"

files.config.toml:
me = "Alex Smith"
email = "Alex@Example.com"
org_domain = "Example.com"
workspace = "work"
output = "preps"
owner = "Alex"
house_rules = "house.md"
state_file = "state.json"
log_file = "log.txt"
after_write = ["python", "after.py"]
noise_rules = "triage.toml"
noise_senders = ['receipts@shop\.example']
mail_skip_folders = ["AInbox - External", "junk email"]


[kind.report]
describe = "weekly 1:1 with {name}, who reports to Alex"
rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

[kind.manager]
describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

[person."Pat Boss"]
kind = "manager"
slug = "pat-boss"
file = "{date}-pat-boss-prep.md"
always_day_before_at = "14:00"

[person."Kim Lee"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "kim-lee"
file = "{date}-kim-lee-catchup-prep.md"
due_same_day_at = "09:30"

[person."Zoë Ñúñez"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "zoe-nunez"
file = "peers/{date}-zoe-nunez-prep.md"

[series."Leads weekly"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-prep.md"
members = ["Sam Jones", "Kim Lee"]
chat = "Leads chat"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]
absorbs = "Leads pre-meet"
due_previous_working_day_at = "15:00"

[series."Leads pre-meet"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-premeet-prep.md"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "10:00", end = "10:30"}, {day = "Fri", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]

[series."Weekly note"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{week}-weekly-note.md"

[aliases]
"Sam J" = "Sam Jones"
"Patricia Boss" = "Pat Boss"

files.config.toml:
me = "Alex Smith"
email = "Alex@Example.com"
org_domain = "Example.com"
workspace = "work"
output = "preps"
owner = "Alex"
house_rules = "house.md"
state_file = "state.json"
log_file = "log.txt"
after_write = ["python", "after.py"]
noise_rules = "triage.toml"
noise_senders = ['receipts@shop\.example']
mail_skip_folders = ["AInbox - External", "junk email"]


[kind.report]
describe = "weekly 1:1 with {name}, who reports to Alex"
rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

[kind.manager]
describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

[person."Pat Boss"]
kind = "manager"
slug = "pat-boss"
file = "{date}-pat-boss-prep.md"
always_day_before_at = "14:00"

[person."Kim Lee"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "kim-lee"
file = "{date}-kim-lee-catchup-prep.md"
due_same_day_at = "09:30"

[person."Zoë Ñúñez"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "zoe-nunez"
file = "peers/{date}-zoe-nunez-prep.md"

[series."Leads weekly"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-prep.md"
members = ["Sam Jones", "Kim Lee"]
chat = "Leads chat"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]
absorbs = "Leads pre-meet"
due_previous_working_day_at = "15:00"

[series."Leads pre-meet"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{date}-leads-premeet-prep.md"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "10:00", end = "10:30"}, {day = "Fri", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]

[series."Weekly note"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{week}-weekly-note.md"

[aliases]
"Sam J" = "Sam Jones"
"Patricia Boss" = "Pat Boss"
files.house.md:
- No code names.
- Dates as dates.
files.kinds/manager.md:
Read the manager notes.
Then the summaries.
files.triage.toml:
[[rule]]
sender = 'news@vendor\.example$'
action = 'delete'

[[rule]]
sender = '@example\.com$'
match = '^Accepted: '
action = 'delete'

[[rule]]
sender = 'alerts@'
match = '(?i)\bsmart detection\b'
action = 'resolve'

[[rule]]
sender = 'keep@'
action = 'review'

files.config.toml:
me = "Alex Smith"
email = "Alex@Example.com"
org_domain = "Example.com"
workspace = "work"
output = "preps"
owner = "Alex"
house_rules = "house.md"
state_file = "state.json"
log_file = "log.txt"
after_write = ["python", "after.py"]
noise_rules = "triage.toml"
noise_senders = ['receipts@shop\.example']
mail_skip_folders = ["AInbox - External", "junk email"]


[kind.report]
describe = "weekly 1:1 with {name}, who reports to Alex"
rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."

[kind.manager]
describe = "1:1 with {name}, Alex's manager"
rules_file = "kinds/manager.md"
companion = "{date}-{slug}-preread.md"
companion_rules = "200 to 470 words."
every_transcript = true
update_rules = "Mark anything for the pre-read 'mention in the room'."

[kind.peer]
describe = "catch-up with {name}, a peer"
rules = "Read across the peers."

[kind.leads]
describe = "the leads meeting"
rules = "Carry forward open actions."
context_commands = [["python", "status.py"], ["tool", "--flag", "x"]]

[person."Sam Jones"]
kind = "report"
slug = "sam-jones"
file = "{date}-sam-jones-prep.md"

[person."Pat Boss"]

slug = "pat-boss"
file = "{date}-pat-boss-prep.md"

[person."Kim Lee"]

slug = "kim-lee"
file = "{date}-kim-lee-catchup-prep.md"
due_same_day_at = "09:30"

[person."Zoë Ñúñez"]
kind = "peer"
slug = "zoe-nunez"
file = "peers/{date}-zoe-nunez-prep.md"

members = ["Sam Jones", "Kim Lee"]

absorbs = "Leads pre-meet"
due_previous_working_day_at = "15:00"

file = "{date}-leads-premeet-prep.md"
weekly = [{day = "Tue", start = "10:00", end = "10:30"}, {day = "Fri", start = "11:00", end = "12:00"}]

[series."Weekly note"]
kind = "leads"
file = "{week}-weekly-note.md"

[aliases]
"Sam J" = "Sam Jones"
"Patricia Boss" = "Pat Boss"

rules = "Read {name}'s notes in team/{slug}/ longitudinally. A brace in prose {like this} is fine."
